1e3c0a9ff4278727e464daf42f806945c83c0f38.sourceText:
| 示例 | 重点 | 说明 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 示例 1 | 旧回调写法对比 | 普通函数、函数对象都能做回调，但 lambda 更适合局部短逻辑 |
| 示例 2 | 参数和返回值 | 返回类型通常可推导，分支返回不同类型时要显式写清楚 |
| 示例 3 | 捕获列表 | `[x]` 拷贝，`[&x]` 引用 |
| 示例 4 | `mutable` | 修改的是 lambda 内部副本，不影响外部变量 |
| 示例 5 | STL 算法 | `sort`、`find_if`、`count_if` 常和 lambda 配合 |
| 示例 6 | 生命周期 | 保存回调、异步回调、线程回调中不要随便引用捕获局部变量 |
| 示例 7 | `[this]` | 捕获当前对象指针，Lambda 访问的是原对象 |
| 示例 8 | `[*this]` | C++17 起捕获当前对象副本，与原对象状态分离 |
1e3c0a9ff4278727e464daf42f806945c83c0f38.translatedText:
| Example | Key point | Note |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Example 1 | Comparison with old callback style | Ordinary functions and function objects can both serve as callbacks, but lambdas are better suited for short local logic |
| Example 2 | Parameters and return value | The return type can usually be deduced; when branches return different types, it must be written explicitly |
| Example 3 | Capture list | `[x]` copy,`[&x]` reference |
| Example 4 | `mutable` | What is modified is the lambda's internal copy and does not affect the external variable |
| Example 5 | STL algorithms | `sort`、`find_if`、`count_if` are often used with lambdas |
| Example 6 | Lifetime | Do not casually capture local variables by reference in stored callbacks, asynchronous callbacks, or thread callbacks |
| Example 7 | `[this]` | Captures the current object pointer; the lambda accesses the original object |
| Example 8 | `[*this]` | C++17 captures a copy of the current object starting from 17, separated from the original object's state |

1e6fd4ef1cb1cf63b02091602e35a8b357a0fa98.translatedText: The tutorial and the official README describe scan_topic as an absolute name; the current 2\.6\.10 subscription implementation does not enforce this form, and this project uses the relative name obstacle_scan, resolved according to ROS rules\. The topic name and the frame_id in the message are also two different things: the name determines which message is received, while frame_id determines how the scan coordinates are interpreted\.[ROS2 topic name rules](https://design.ros2.org/articles/topic_and_service_names.html)
